trust_decision.summary: Untrusted spawn arguments are rewritten for cmd.exe with backtracking-prone backslash regexes in escapeArgument; nothing bounds the work done on attacker-controlled argument strings.

landing_point.why: Only regex-based argument rewriting in the package; the summary says ReDoS in cross-spawn and escape.js is the obvious regex file.

fix_sites.entry_point: spawn()/spawn.sync() public API (index.js:7, index.js:21) via parse() -> parseNonShell on win32 (lib/parse.js:53)
same as above; same function escapeArgument

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists; the only arguable dismissal is that escapeCommand/metaCharsRegExp (lib/util/escape.js:4-8) is a single-char class and not backtracking-prone, which is correct.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Correct qntm.org/cmd escaping: backslash runs before a double quote and at end-of-string must still be doubled (the first published fix 5ff3a07 broke this and needed 640d391); also double meta-char escaping for node_modules/.bin cmd-shims.

O6_input_shapes: long runs of backslashes followed by a double quote (global replace, escape.js:21)
long runs of backslashes not at end of string (end-anchored replace, escape.js:26)
non-string args coerced via template literal (escape.js:15)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: escapeCommand could plausibly apply the same backslash-doubling idiom to the command string
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Command and arguments are escaped side by side (lib/parse.js:52-53); a maintainer could share the backslash handling, but this would be a WHERE-type planted copy that lessons-v2 says falls together.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333), polynomial backtracking in argument escaping

O10_build.project_tests: test/index.test.js exercises spawn end-to-end; escaping branch only runs on win32 (lib/parse.js:28-30), no unit tests for lib/util/escape.js at pinned commit; hidden tests would have to require lib/util/escape.js directly on Linux.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap in a lookahead-only regex (as in 5ff3a07) that drops the captured backslashes and breaks escaping, or cap argument length.

out_of_scope_notes: Pinned package.json is 7.0.3 (package.json:3) while the release commit d35c865 bumps 6.0.5->6.0.6; the escape.js hunks still apply cleanly to the pinned file.
lib/parse.js:10 isCmdShimRegExp runs on the resolved command path, not on arguments; not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; judged tiny from the 6 source files under lib/ and index.js.
